== Course of events ==

Glinda the Good had already demanded that Old Mombi be surrendered to her, after Mombi had tricked General Jinjur by switching appearances with Jellia Jamb. When Old Mombi is discovered in the tent, she transforms into a Shadow in an attempt to flee, but Glinda the Good seals the entrance shut with a wave of her hand, cutting off her escape.

In the aftermath, Glinda the Good pursues the Griffin on the tireless Saw-Horse while Tip and the others follow by air aboard the Gump. Glinda the Good tells the assembled group that she has failed to find Mombi and fears the expedition to rescue Ozma will fail. She later throws a golden thread over the exhausted Griffin, destroying the transformation and revealing Old Mombi in her true form.
